name: pr-size-labeler
desc: Labels PRs size/XS through size/XL by lines changed, and nudges authors to split giant PRs.
notes: Creates the size/* labels automatically
XL threshold is 800+ lines

name: first-touch-welcomer
desc: Posts a friendly welcome comment the first time someone opens an issue or PR.
notes: Skips owners, members, and collaborators
First-timer detection via the search API

name: stale-bot
desc: Marks issues idle 30 days as stale, closes them 7 days later. Any activity resets the clock.
notes: Requires REPO=owner/name env var
STALE_DAYS and CLOSE_AFTER_DAYS configurable

name: branch-sweeper
desc: Deletes the head branch automatically when a PR is merged.
notes: Never touches forks or protected branches (main, develop, release…)

name: conventional-pr-check
desc: Commit status enforcing conventional-commit PR titles: feat:, fix:, chore: and friends.
notes: Make it a required check in branch protection to block merges

name: reviewer-assigner
desc: Auto-assigns reviewers by which paths changed — a self-hosted mini-CODEOWNERS.
notes: Configure path prefixes in reviewers.json
Never assigns the PR author

name: duplicate-issue-hunter
desc: Comments possible duplicates when a new issue's title overlaps existing ones.
notes: Only fires on 2+ keyword overlap — vague issues stay quiet

name: todo-tracker
desc: Opens a tracking issue for every new TODO/FIXME comment pushed to the default branch.
notes: Dedupes by content hash — no duplicates from merges

name: merge-conflict-detector
desc: When the default branch moves, warns open PRs that now conflict.
notes: Retries once after 3s — GitHub computes mergeability async

name: auto-merger
desc: Squash-merges PRs labeled 'automerge' as soon as checks go green.
events: Pull requests, Check runs, Check suites, Status
notes: Repos without CI count as green
Create the automerge label first

name: repo-digest
desc: Opens a weekly digest issue: merged PRs, issue stats, top contributors.
notes: Requires REPO=owner/name env var

name: pr-template-checker
desc: Nudges authors whose PR description is empty or missing template sections.
notes: REQUIRED_SECTIONS env var, e.g. 'summary,test plan'

name: release-drafter
desc: Maintains a running draft release — every merged PR appends its title to the notes, grouped by type.
notes: Groups entries by conventional-commit prefix
Publish the draft whenever you cut a release

name: keyword-issue-labeler
desc: Auto-labels new issues from keywords in the title and body — bug, feature, docs, question…
notes: Configurable keyword → label map in labels.json
Ships with sensible defaults

name: ci-failure-commenter
desc: When CI fails on a PR, comments which checks failed with links — no digging through the checks tab.
notes: Collapses repeat failures into one updated comment

name: pr-aging-bot
desc: Labels open PRs by wait time — fresh/week/stale/ancient — so review backlogs are visible at a glance.
notes: Skips drafts by default (SKIP_DRAFTS=false to include)
Only writes when a PR crosses a tier boundary
Run nightly as a GitHub Action or crontab

name: review-reminder
desc: Nudges requested reviewers when a PR waits 24h+ without review — one reminder each, no spam.
notes: REMIND_AFTER_HOURS configures the wait (default 24)
Tracks reminders via managed comment markers

name: issue-triage-reminder
desc: Flags issues that sit untriaged — no label, assignee, or milestone — with a needs-triage label that clears itself once triaged.
notes: GRACE_HOURS configures the grace period (default 24)
Self-cleaning: label removed when a human triages

name: changelog-checker
desc: Commit status enforcing every PR updates the changelog — or explicitly opts out with a skip label.
notes: CHANGELOG_FILE and SKIP_LABEL are configurable
Re-evaluates when labels change

name: license-header-checker
desc: Fails PRs whose new source files lack a license header — one managed comment lists exactly which files.
perms: statuses: write, pulls: read, issues: write
notes: HEADER_TEXT and SOURCE_EXTENSIONS configurable
Only checks newly added files, not existing ones

name: pr-path-labeler
desc: Labels PRs by which directories they touch — area/frontend, area/backend — using your repo's existing labels.
notes: Optional path-labels.json for explicit prefix→label mapping
Never invents labels — only applies ones that already exist

name: contributor-milestones
desc: Celebrates contributors — welcome comment on first merged PR, shout-outs at 5/10/25/50/100 merges.
notes: Recognition drives repeat contribution
Bot accounts are ignored

name: breaking-change-guard
desc: Blocks merges that declare breaking changes until a maintainer acknowledges with the breaking-change label.
perms: statuses: write, pulls: read, issues: write
notes: Detects feat!: titles and BREAKING CHANGE footers
Re-checks on label changes so acknowledgment flips it green

name: release-reminder
desc: Opens a tracking issue when unreleased commits pile up — closes itself once you ship.
notes: THRESHOLD_COMMITS sets the trigger (default 20)
Updates one managed issue instead of spamming

name: docs-link-checker
desc: Scans your markdown for dead links — one self-updating issue lists them, closes itself when fixed.
notes: Concurrent link checking with per-URL caching
HEAD-then-GET fallback for picky servers

name: issue-link-checker
desc: Validates external links in new issues — one comment flags dead repro links before triage wastes time on them.
notes: Skips github.com links to save rate quota
Edits re-check, comment updates in place

name: issue-form-validator
desc: Enforces your issue template — labels issues missing required sections, auto-clears when they fix it.
notes: REQUIRED_SECTIONS configures which headings must be filled
Rejects placeholder content, not just empty sections

name: dependency-update-grouper
desc: Labels dependabot/renovate PRs patch/minor/major from semver in the title — batch the safe ones, review the rest.
notes: Exactly one deps/* label per PR
Pairs well with auto-merger: auto-merge deps/patch only

name: flaky-test-tracker
desc: Catches flaky CI — checks that pass on retry with zero code changes — and files tracking issues.
notes: FLAKE_THRESHOLD controls sensitivity (default 3)
State persisted in flaky-state.json

name: merge-queue-assistant
desc: A minimal merge queue — label PRs queue/merge and the bot enforces FIFO order with queue/next promotion.
notes: Oldest queued PR is always the head
Head merging or closing promotes the next in line automatically

name: discussion-triage-bot
desc: Keeps discussions from rotting — one self-updating issue lists questions nobody has answered.
notes: Uses the GraphQL API — discussions aren't in REST
Verified live against github-bot-store itself

name: project-board-sync
desc: Keeps Projects v2 boards honest — new issues/PRs appear automatically, cards move as work progresses.
perms: issues: read, pulls: read, projects: write
notes: Assigned work moves to In Progress, closed/merged to Done
GraphQL-powered; degrades gracefully if the board has no Status field
